title: [review] message.rs:238: D-flag/dodag_id inconsistency
description: Dao::write_to always sets D-flag=1 (line 238) but conditionally writes DODAGID bytes (line 244-246). When dodag_id=None with global instance ID (<0x80), the check at line 230-232 passes, resulting in base_len=4 but D=1. The wire format claims 20 bytes (D=1) but only 4 are written, causing receivers to read past buffer bounds. Fix: reject dodag_id=None unconditionally since LICHEN requires D=1.
close_reason: Fixed: Simplified Dao::write_to to require dodag_id unconditionally since LICHEN sets D=1 always. Now extracts dodag_id via ok_or() and uses const BASE_LEN=20, eliminating the dead conditional code paths.
